newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bank loans rise in February - Banking Assoc.
newsitem.headline: Italy bank loans rise in February - Banking Assoc.

text.p: Loans extended by Italian commercial banks rose slightly in February while bank deposits continued a slow expansion, the Italian Banking Association (ABI) said in a monthly report.
Loans rose 3.21 percent year-on-year to 883 trillion lire, after a 2.23 percent rise in January.
"In a context in which no clear signals can be observed of a revival of the economic cycle, the rate of growth in bank deposits remains moderate in these first months of 1997," said the report.
Lira loans grew 3.44 percent in February to 799 trillion after a 2.91 percent rise in January while foreign currency loans rose 1.05 percent after 4.03 percent decline in January.
